tasks.subject: Task 1: Thread-safe visibility + evdev decode helper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Make `gt_hud_visible` safe to write from a second thread, and add a pure, host-tested classifier mapping an evdev key code to Menu / Volume / Other.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` — shared/pure section (classifier + `gt_menu_toggle` param), interposer decl (`gt_hud_visible`), `main()` asserts under `#ifdef GT_REMAP_TEST`.
- Test: `tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` (unchanged runner).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `gt_menu_toggle` signature is `int gt_menu_toggle(gt_tap_state *s, volatile int *visible, int is_menu, int is_down)`; existing host-test calls (plain `int vis`) still compile + pass.
- [ ] `gt_hud_visible` is `static volatile int gt_hud_visible;`.
- [ ] `gt_evkey_class(int code)` returns `GT_EVK_MENU` for 312, `GT_EVK_VOL` for 114/115, `GT_EVK_OTHER` otherwise (354 included).
- [ ] `main()` asserts the classifier (312/114/115/354/0) + one evdev-style tap sequence (MENU down/up flips on; MENU down, VOL down, MENU up → no flip) and still prints `remap ok`.

**Verify:** `sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` → exits 0, prints `remap ok`.

See plan `docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-26-hud-stage2-software-fna.md` (Task 1) for the exact code to add.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Software-renderer draw (SDL_RenderPresent)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Draw the HUD on SDL_Renderer ports (Apotris) by interposing `SDL_RenderPresent` and blitting the composed HUD RGBA through the SDL_Renderer API (backend-agnostic), with an independent crash-latch. Extract F34's 1×/sec sample/compose throttle into a shared `gt_hud_refresh` both draw paths call.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` — interposer half only (extract `gt_hud_refresh`; add `gt_sw_dead`, SDL_Render resolver, `gt_hud_draw_sw`, `SDL_RenderPresent` interposer).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Throttle block in `gt_hud_draw` extracted verbatim into `static void gt_hud_refresh(void)` (after cache statics, before `gt_hud_draw`); `gt_hud_draw` now calls it (behaviour identical).
- [ ] `SDL_RenderPresent(SDL_Renderer *)` interposed via `dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, …)`, real called every frame, HUD drawn before it when `gt_hud_visible`.
- [ ] SDL_Render entry points resolved once via `dlsym(RTLD_NEXT, …)`; any missing symbol / texture-create failure latches independent `gt_sw_dead`; port still presents.
- [ ] `SDL_PIXELFORMAT_ABGR8888` streaming texture on the passed renderer (recreated on renderer/size change), `SDL_BLENDMODE_BLEND`, uploaded only when composed buffer changed, copied top-right via `gt_hud_rect` over `SDL_GetRendererOutputSize`.
- [ ] `make shim` builds cleanly; `sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` still passes.

**Verify:** `make shim && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` → build lists `assets/gt-input-remap.so`; test exits 0. (`make shim` needs network — run with sandbox disabled. Behavioural proof = Task 5 gate.)

See plan (Task 2) for exact code.

tasks.subject: Task 3: evdev toggle thread + swallow-only + -pthread
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a detached background thread that reads the Menu button directly from evdev (discovered by capability) as the sole HUD toggle authority across all engines; strip the toggle call from the SDL interposers (leaving swallow, Decision A); add `-pthread` to the shim build.

**Files:**
- Modify: `assets/gt-input-remap.c` — interposer half (includes, device discovery, thread, constructor start; `gt_hud_intercept` → swallow-only).
- Modify: `Makefile` — `shim` target: add `-pthread` to the `gt-input-remap.so` compile/link.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `gt_hud_intercept` no longer calls `gt_menu_toggle`; still returns `gt_menu_swallow(b)` (raw 11/14 swallowed) + keeps debug logging. `gt_tap` touched only by the thread.
- [ ] Capability-based discovery opens the `/dev/input/event*` whose `EV_KEY` bitmap has BOTH 312 and 354; returns `-1` (benign) if none.
- [ ] Detached pthread, started from the constructor when `gt_hud_on()`, drives `gt_menu_toggle(&gt_tap, &gt_hud_visible, …)`: MENU(312)→`is_menu=1`, VOL(114/115)→`is_menu=0`, else skip; `value==2` skipped; any read/open error exits the thread quietly.
- [ ] Thread never `EVIOCGRAB`s the device.
- [ ] `make shim` links `-pthread` and builds cleanly; `sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` still passes.

**Verify:** `make shim && sh tests/test-05-input-remap.sh` → build lists `assets/gt-input-remap.so`; test exits 0. (`make shim` needs network — sandbox disabled. Behavioural proof = Task 5 gate.)

See plan (Task 3) for exact code.

tasks.subject: Task 5: Device gate — per-engine verification (RG SP)
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove on-device that the software-renderer HUD and the universal evdev toggle work across every engine, and that nothing F34 verified regressed.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** None (verification). May yield a one-line `GT_EVCODE_*` correction in `assets/gt-input-remap.c` and/or a fill-in of the Task 4 device-gate placeholder.

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] **Apotris (software path):** HUD appears; a single Menu tap toggles on/off; battery/brightness/volume/time live + correct; toggle-off pristine; no crash. `GT_HUD_DEBUG` shows `present path = SDL_RenderPresent`.
- [ ] **Celeste (GL draw + evdev toggle):** HUD appears (first visual confirm of FNA3D GL draw) AND a Menu tap toggles it under mono; no crash.
- [ ] **Regression — F34 GL ports** (Balatro, BYTEPATH, a GameMaker title, Tunics!, 2048 Plus): each still toggles (via evdev), Menu still swallowed from the game, F25/F26/F31 input intact.
- [ ] **keymon combo:** Menu+Vol brightness still works during a port and does NOT spuriously toggle the HUD.
- [ ] **`GT_HUD_DEBUG` trace** captured for one software and one GL port (toggle device discovery + present/swap path).

**Verify:** device session on `ssh root@10.0.1.16`: `make shim`, install shim via scp-temp+`mv` (keep `.pre-f35.bak`), launch each engine's port, toggle the HUD, capture `GT_HUD_DEBUG` + Camille's visual confirmation per item. Software evidence must come from a real Apotris run (`SDL_RenderPresent` log + visible HUD); GL/toggle evidence from a real Celeste run (`SDL_GL_SwapWindow` log + HUD toggling under mono). Never overwrite the running `.so` in place.

See plan (Task 5) for the step-by-step device procedure.
